minecraft:particle_initialization.per_update_expression: v.te = v.particle_age + 0.075;v.hd = math.max(math.sqrt(v.target_deltax * v.target_deltax + v.target_deltaz * v.target_deltaz), 0.01);v.fx = -v.target_deltax / v.hd;v.fz = -v.target_deltaz / v.hd;v.big = math.clamp(0.75 * v.entity_height + 0.8, 1.5, 3.0);v.x0 = 0.5 * v.entity_width + 0.35;v.x1 = math.max(v.x0 + 0.3, math.max(v.hd, 1.5) - 0.5 * v.big);v.ln = 1.1 + 0.25 * v.entity_width;v.tb = 0.6 + 0.45 * (0.05 + 0.7 * v.particle_random_1);v.cp = math.clamp((v.te - 0.6) / 0.45, 0, 1);v.cx = v.x0 + (v.x1 - v.x0) * (0.65 * v.cp + 0.35 * v.cp * v.cp * (3 - 2 * v.cp));v.cs = math.min(v.cp / 0.55, 1);v.ch = v.big * (0.55 + 0.45 * v.cs * v.cs * (3 - 2 * v.cs));v.sn = v.te - v.tb;v.lt = (v.particle_random_4 - 0.5) * 2 * v.ln;

relative_position: v.target_deltay * math.clamp((v.cx + (0.12 + 0.25 * v.particle_random_3) * v.ch) / v.hd, 0, 1) + v.ch * (0.2 + 0.55 * v.particle_random_2) + 0.12 * math.sin(720 * v.sn + 360 * v.particle_random_4)
